title: Arizona water evidence for defensible industrial growth
question: Which records show whether industrial growth has defensible water capacity?
why_it_matters: Industrial strategy in a water-constrained region depends on water rights, provider capacity, reuse, treatment, discharge, drought exposure, and public legitimacy.
current_support: FTFN has ADWR water governance context, ADWR assured and adequate water supply criteria, and Arizona utility-regulation context.
candidate_records: specific ADWR assured or adequate water supply application
next_action: Add provider, permit, facility-demand, discharge, and reuse-plan sources before facility-level water claims.
notes: ADWR criteria improve the governance layer but do not prove facility water sufficiency.
